identificationModule.briefTitle: Clinical Trial of Standard Versus Goal-Directed Perioperative Fluid Management (GDT) for Patients Undergoing Liver Resection
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Prospective Randomized Controlled Clinical Trial of Standard Compared to Goal-directed Perioperative Fluid Management (GDT) for Patients Undergoing Liver Resection

armGroups.label: Standard fluid management
armGroups.description: Prospective single-blinded randomized trial. Eligible patients will be consented for the trial prior to surgery. However randomization will not occur until the operating room. After the liver has been resected, intraoperative randomization will be done by envelopes.

armGroups.label: Goal directed fluid therapy
armGroups.description: Prospective single-blinded randomized trial. Eligible patients will be consented for the trial prior to surgery. However randomization will not occur until the operating room. After the liver has been resected, intraoperative randomization will be done by envelopes.
interventionNames: Device: Goal directed fluid therapy with the Edwards EV1000 system

interventions.name: Standard fluid management
interventions.description: The patient will receive standard fluid management

interventions.name: Goal directed fluid therapy with the Edwards EV1000 system
interventions.description: This arm will have fluid therapy guided by the Edwards EV1000 system.
